messages:
ashley_sr: POC with Quenton Health hitting streaming failures. Client (RN EventSource polyfill) shows partial JSON and then parser error. ~8% of requests. request id: qh_req_21

quentin_cust: Error: Unexpected end of JSON input. Network shows 200 then connection close mid-message. We're behind an edge proxy.

elaine_dev: can you paste a raw SSE capture and client stack? Also are you using gzip? proxies often buffer compressed frames.

support-bot: logs for qh_req_21: upstream closed (499) after 4.1s; bytes_sent: 512; model: redwood-compat-claude; region: eu-west-1

ryan_infra: 499 indicates client closed the connection. Likely due to client timeout or edge buffer. Quick checks: curl -N to inspect raw stream, try Accept-Encoding: identity to avoid compression buffering. We can also enable temporary keepalive heartbeats for this tenant to see if edge is dropping idle connections.

elaine_dev: if client can't be changed immediately, sending NDJSON events or providing a small parser that accumulates until a full JSON object arrives helps. Example parser sketch provided in DM.

quentin_cust: will run curl -N and try identity encoding. Appreciate heartbeat option.

support-bot: heartbeat enabled for qh_req_21 at 1779301200. keepalive interval 2s for 12h.

ashley_sr: thanks team. Next steps: infra to check edge buffering config and share recommendations; devex to provide RN parser snippet + NDJSON envelope; customer to run curl capture and share logs. Schedule screenshare if issues persist.

quentin_cust: running tests now, will report back with captures. :thumbsup:
